cases.goal: Determine whether a zstd compression and decompression roundtrip preserves arbitrary binary bytes exactly. Use authoritative primary evidence and a real executable experiment, choose the method and tool route, identify limitations, independently verify the result, and preserve provenance.

Evaluate whether a fixed-step numerical integration method materially drifts in total energy on a simple harmonic oscillator over many periods. Choose a sufficient quantitative method, run an executable comparison, characterize uncertainty and limitations, independently cross-check the consequential result, and produce a decision-quality conclusion with provenance.

Establish the current stable release identity of a named open-source package from authoritative primary release evidence, verify source and version provenance independently, identify material ambiguity or limitations, and produce a scoped answer with provenance.

Determine whether the median of a supplied numeric dataset changes materially after removing one extreme outlier. Choose and justify the quantitative method, perform the calculation, independently verify the result with a distinct route, state limitations, and produce a decision-quality answer with provenance.

Determine whether a standard archive-and-extract workflow preserves executable permission bits for regular files. Discover the least-friction executable tool route, run a real experiment, identify limitations, independently verify the consequential observation, and preserve provenance.

acceptance.composition_canary_requirement: Role-specific tool/experiment discovery query must remove whole-goal question operators and yield at least one subject-relevant candidate from unchanged existing discovery, or localize the next generic blocker without modifying ASTRA.
